overloads.semanticRole: The VP SET SHEET NAME command renames a sheet in the document loaded in vpAreaName .

constraints: Indexing of sheet starts at 0; if sheet is omitted, the current sheet is renamed.
The new name cannot contain any of the characters: * : [ ] ? \ /
The command does nothing if: the new name contains forbidden characters, the new name is blank, the new name already exists, or the passed sheet index does not exist.
